_comment: Release gates for CAI-L4-CI-001 that need a person, a tenant or an approval, and so cannot be decided by scripts/release/certify-release.mjs alone. Each gate has one status: PASS (evidenced; 'evidence' says where), FAIL, BLOCKED (cannot be run yet; 'blockedBy' says why), or REQUIRES FOUNDER APPROVAL. A status changes only when the evidence named here exists. The certifier prints these beside the gates it checks itself; it never upgrades one.

gates.title: Clean install of the delivered managed solution (cca6f657…) as a customer administrator
gates.evidence: 20 Nov 2026, CAI-A6-CLEAN: uninstall 1.0.3.1 → import of the released managed solution; tenant log tenant-log-1036.md (Release evidence library); scratchpad evidence phase-c-2026-11-20.md #6. Bundle revision 2 ships the same managed solution, so this stands for it.

gates.title: Managed upgrade from the previous release keeps data, configuration and flow states
gates.evidence: 19 Nov 2026, CAI-TEST: 1.0.3.5 → 1.0.3.6 in the UI; 42 contracts, 602 evidence, 49 reviews, 9 job runs unchanged (scripts/cai-release/1.0.3.6/README.md). Upgrades from 1.0.3.4 and earlier: INSTALL §4 with their 10-19 Nov tests.

gates.title: Business workflow: upload → extraction → register → review card → approval → evidence → agent answer → daily recompute
gates.evidence: 19 Nov 2026, CAI-TEST (upgraded environment with Copilot capacity): SYN-N09 upload, review card with unverified-excerpt labels, approve with confirmed 6 months → 2027-06-30 = truth.json, SUPERSEDED handling, SYN-N10 recompute, agent refusal to call excerpts verbatim (scripts/cai-release/1.0.3.6/README.md).

gates.title: The same workflow on the clean-install environment
gates.blockedBy: CAI-A6-CLEAN has no Copilot Studio capacity: the SharePoint trigger fires and the run fails in 410 ms with 'insufficient Copilot Credits' (20 Nov; INSTALL §9, PR #533). Needs a Copilot Studio billing plan on that environment (founder; Microsoft billing).

gates.title: Tenant/team isolation, least privilege, unauthorized requests
gates.evidence: 9-10 Nov 2026: second licensed user sees only own team's contracts, also after a team change; user without team gets no data (INSTALL §10, MANIFEST knownLimitations); role CAI Contract Reader read-only, 9 privileges (package check C5, 21 Nov 9/9).

gates.evidence: INSTALL §1 (mandatory) and §9 (symptom, fix path PPAC → Licensing → Copilot Studio → billing plans) in bundle revision 2.
